title: lint_handoffs.py historical debt requiring case-by-case judgment or permanent acknowledgment (H001-structural/H003/H004/H005/H006-CONDITIONAL/H007/H009/H013) -- 292 of 458 findings, split out of ISS-0626
symptom:
Triage of ISS-0626 (263 BLOCKER + 195 MAJOR + 1 MINOR = 459 total findings across 2270 handoffs, re-measured 2026-08-08: 148 H003 + 88 H008 + 69 H007 + 53 H013 + 38 H009 + 34 H004 + 11 H001 + 9 H002 + 5 H005 + 3 H006 + 1 H010) split the corpus into a safe-mechanical subset (H002 9, H008 88, H010 1 -- fixed in WF03-GH594-20260808 itself) and this remainder, which needs either case-by-case judgment or a permanent honest-record decision rather than a blind repair script:

- H003 (148 BLOCKER): completed_at precedes started_at, NOT a whole-hour offset (that subset is H013). No source in the file recovers the true timestamp -- any correction is fabrication dressed as data.
- H004 (34 BLOCKER): started_at precedes created_at. Same unrecoverable-history problem as H003, opposite direction.
- H013 (53 BLOCKER): completed_at precedes started_at by a value within 0.1h of a whole-hour offset (confirmed by sampling: 3.9-4.0h clusters), the documented signature of `.ToUniversalTime()` omission. The offset is algorithmically computable, but correcting it still requires inferring which timezone/DST rule applied at write time -- a fact not recorded anywhere in the file. Needs an explicit decision on whether hour-offset correction clears the 'no judgment' bar or is still a guess.
- H005 (5 BLOCKER): status is COMPLETED but completed_at is unset outright. No value to recover from any source in the file.
- H009 (38 MAJOR): a PENDING/IN_PROGRESS step has later COMPLETED steps in the same run. Marking the orphaned step COMPLETED or FAILED after the fact fabricates evidence that was never recorded; this is a real historical process irregularity, not a data-entry error.
- H001 structural-typo subset (bracket/quote mismatches that are not encoding corruption -- sample: handoffs/ADHOC-gh402-db-cleanup-hang-20260803/step-00-backend-dev-db-cleanup.json has a `]` closing an object that needs `}` at line 46): requires understanding which delimiter was intended, i.e. per-file human/agent judgment. (The other ~7 of 11 H001 files -- PowerShell curly-quote corruption and cp1252-not-UTF8 encoding -- were routed to CODE-DESIGNER in WF03-GH594-20260808 as a verify-before-write repair candidate, distinct from this structural-typo subset.)
- H006 CONDITIONAL subset (1 of 3 BLOCKER): result.status value 'CONDITIONAL' has no unambiguous 1:1 mapping onto the 5-value legal enum (PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/SKIPPED) the way FAILED->FAIL and PARTIAL_PASS->PARTIAL do. (Those 2 unambiguous renames were routed to CODE-DESIGNER in WF03-GH594-20260808.)
- H007 (69 MAJOR, but only ~10 distinct files -- all in run WF02-api07-20260523): uses an early alternate schema (workflow_id+sequence instead of run_id+step). Values are present under different key names, so this is a schema-migration/backward-compat decision (does the file get its keys renamed, or does the schema/lint tool learn to recognize the old shape?) that should be made explicitly, not silently scripted alongside the H002/H008/H010 fixes.
root_cause: Same root cause as ISS-0626: ~3 months (2026-05-22 to 2026-08-07) of bookkeeping directives in CLAUDE.md being followed for work product but not for the record of the work, per the 2026-08-05 pipeline audit already cited in CLAUDE.md's Bookkeeping Is Not Optional section. This issue exists specifically because CLAUDE.md's own 'wrong-guess fix to an audit trail is worse than an honestly-flagged gap' principle means these categories cannot be resolved the same way H002/H008/H010 were.
acceptance_criteria: For H003/H004/H005/H009: decide and implement a permanent acknowledgment mechanism (e.g. a lint SUPPRESSION/ACKNOWLEDGED marker file or an allowlist keyed by handoff_id+code, dated and reasoned) so these stay visible in the audit trail as known, accepted historical gaps rather than either being silently re-flagged forever or fabricated shut. Do NOT invent timestamp or status values.

For H013: make an explicit, documented decision (not a silent default) on whether whole-hour-offset correction is acceptable given the offset is mechanically computable but the causal timezone is not recorded in the file. If accepted, implement as its own reviewed script separate from H003/H004. If rejected, fold into the same acknowledgment mechanism as H003/H004.
For the H001 structural-typo subset: repair case-by-case with a human-in-the-loop or CODE-DESIGNER-reviewed diff per file (small count, ~1-4 files) -- do not blind-script bracket guesses.

For H006 CONDITIONAL: decide the correct target enum value (or add CONDITIONAL to LEGAL_RESULT_STATUS in tools/lint_handoffs.py if it turns out to be a legitimate historical result state that predates the enum) by reading the actual handoff file's context.

For H007: decide whether to rename workflow_id/sequence -> run_id/step in the ~10 affected WF02-api07-20260523 files, or teach lint_handoffs.py to recognize the old schema shape as an accepted historical variant. Either is acceptable; silence is not.

Re-run tools/lint_handoffs.py after each phase and confirm the addressed category's count trends to 0 (fix) or the finding count is unchanged but is now covered by the acknowledgment mechanism (permanent-record categories)
This is deliberately NOT a single run -- expect this to be split further per category as each is tackled, following the same phased-issue pattern used for ISS-0624/ISS-0625
notes:
Split out of ISS-0626/GH-594 during WF03-GH594-20260808 Step 1 (ISSUE-FIXER diagnosis). ISS-0626 itself is scoped down to the safe-mechanical subset (H002 result-string unwrap, H008 BOM strip, H010 registry backfill) which CODE-DESIGNER designs a repair script for in that same run. This issue covers everything left over: 148 H003 + 34 H004 + 53 H013 + 5 H005 + 38 H009 + ~4 H001-structural + 1 H006-CONDITIONAL + 69/~10-file H007 = the categories where a wrong-guess fix risks making the audit trail worse than the current honestly-flagged gap, per CLAUDE.md's Bookkeeping Is Not Optional section and the same principle applied when GH-495 was split into ISS-0624/ISS-0625.

WF03-GH596-20260808 Step 1 (ISSUE-FIXER, 2026-08-08): re-verified the acknowledgment-mechanism-first assessment against a fresh full-corpus lint_handoffs.py run (250 BLOCKER + 110 MAJOR + 1 MINOR across 2275 handoffs; per-code: H003 148, H004 34, H005 5, H009 38, H013 53, H007 69, H006 1, H001 9, H008 3, H010 1 -- matches this issue's snapshot). Confirmed: of the 6 remaining categories, only H003/H004/H005/H009 (225 of 292 findings) share a common mechanism need; H013/H001-structural/H006-CONDITIONAL/H007 are each irreducibly a distinct per-file or per-policy judgment call and do not benefit from being bundled with the others. Scoped this run to the acknowledgment mechanism for H003/H004/H005/H009 only and routed to CODE-DESIGNER (handoff 06e8f858-2ef9-4fad-8798-5a631d3c8e19) with a diagnosis built on two pieces of existing prior art already in this repo rather than a novel design: (1) tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json's content-keyed baseline (severity|code|file|line|message -- the message text already embeds the actual timestamp/count values in H003/H004/H005/H009, so a genuinely new/changed finding cannot silently match an old acknowledgment entry) for storage shape and matching semantics; (2) tools/lint_test_wiring.py's KNOWN_UNATTACHED ledger (a 4th reported-but-non-gating bucket, explicitly still counted and printed, 'EMPTY is the intended steady state') for the exit-code/bucket semantics. The design explicitly must NOT be confused with or merged into --changed mode's existing preexisting_file_finding_codes/preexisting_run_finding_codes diff logic (GH-594) -- that mechanism answers 'did this branch introduce this finding'; the new one answers 'has this specific historical finding been reviewed and accepted as permanent record'. Remaining categories (H013 53, H001-structural ~4 files, H006-CONDITIONAL 1, H007 69/~10 files = 127 findings) are unchanged and still tracked here for individual future runs, each its own distinct judgment call as this issue's acceptance criteria already anticipated.
